title: Answer: no shared position, though Eddington tied volition to quantum indeterminacy

statements.text: The view takes no shared position on free will. It aims to give consciousness a causal role, which Howell disputes. Eddington held that the decision among the behaviors that quantum theory leaves open is what is called volition.

sources.quote: the decision between the possible behaviours is what we call volition
Consciousness —or at least the components of consciousness —is thus integrated into physical causation.
